race.description: Real Punters Play Here Tabtouch Hcp (C3)
race.comment: Although up in class MODERN GIRL (3) looks the one to beat. Huge maiden win two back then led throughout to score in a Class 1 last time. Skips a grade but has upside and is expected to go close again. BUNDABERG (4) turned in a strong performance first-up when in the money at Belmont Park but was well off best at Belmont Park over 1400m after being prominent at the turn. This is easier and gets chance to bounce back. RUN PATTIE RUN (5) is yet to fill a placing in two runs since resuming from a spell, the latest when seventh over 1300m at Northam. Has further improvement to come and is sure to be about the mark. HYPERREAL (2) was in the firing line on the bend and finished second last start over 1300m at Northam, beaten 1.75 lengths. Close to a win and will take plenty of beating. RUNFORROB (9) is better than last run and worth another chance.
